dogecoin.text: So, Dogecoin is now in the quantum realm? Fantastic! Just what we needed—more ways for our investments to vanish faster than my motivation on a Monday. Who knew crypto needed a sci-fi twist to stay relevant?

Grayscale backing Dogecoin is like putting a tuxedo on a golden retriever. Sure, it looks fancy, but deep down, it's still just a pup chasing its tail. Can we really expect it to lead the pack, or is this just another wild chase?
